description: Window cleaning for Serene Hills custom homes on preserved Hill Country land. Tall glass reached from the ground, $10 per window outside. Text us.
intro: Serene Hills is a custom home community where most of the land stays wild. CleanzATX works here, and tall Hill Country glass is the kind of job a water fed pole handles best.

sections.h2: What Serene Hills homes are like
paragraphs: Serene Hills sits on 456 acres, and 342 of them are preserved. A cap of 25% impervious cover keeps houses spread out, with roughly 295 to 339 lots in total. Custom builders do most of the work here, so you rarely see two houses alike. Homes run from about 2,500 to 6,100 square feet and sell between $800K and $2.6M. Serene Hills Elementary and a network of trails are part of the neighborhood. It is not gated, though many residents reach it by way of The Hills gate. Serene Hills HOA covers the community.

Custom means custom glass. We see arched tops, clerestory rows, floor to ceiling corners and big sliders that open to patios. Every house comes with its own set of access questions, so we walk the house before we price anything complex.

sections.h2: What Serene Hills windows deal with
paragraphs: Preserved land means native cedar, oak and brush right against the property line. That brings pollen in season, cedar from December to February and live oak in March and April, plus spider webs on eaves and window corners. Limestone is common in the stonework here, and limestone dust drifts onto lower panes. Leaf litter packs into tracks.

Hill Country views also mean south and west exposure. Afternoon sun makes any streak or water spot easy to spot from across the room. Irrigation on larger lawns can leave white mineral rings on lower glass. We use water near 0 TDS so panes dry clean, and hard water removal at $10 per pane takes care of older spots.

We schedule this community with the neighboring Hills areas in mind, since the gate approach is shared. Stone is cleaned only with soft wash at low pressure, never blasted. Upper story glass and tall entry windows are reached with water fed poles, which saves hauling ladders around slopes. Interior windows are done by hand, with drop cloths and cotton covered ladders on two story rooms. Many owners also book a house soft wash for stucco and a roof soft wash, since preserved land keeps shade and algae close.

A 4,000 square foot Serene Hills home comes to about $400 for exterior windows. The outside takes close to three to four hours, and adding the inside is another two hours or so. Ask about Quarterly, which takes 15% off.

faq.q: Do you need the gate code to get in?
faq.a: Reach this community through The Hills gate or the usual entrances. If a gate needs a code or call box, share it when you text and we plan the drive in.

faq.q: Can you clean arched and clerestory windows?
faq.a: Yes. Water fed poles reach up to three stories from the ground. For high interior glass, we use cotton covered ladders and drop cloths.

faq.q: Will you pressure wash my stone?
faq.a: No. Limestone is never pressure washed, only soft washed. Our 12V soft wash system uses low pressure and a cleaner that works on algae without damaging the stone.

faq.q: What does a custom home here cost?
faq.a: Exterior windows are $10 per window, or about $0.10 per square foot. A 4,000 square foot home is about $400. Inside and out is $15 per window, and screens are $5.
Most Serene Hills owners do two to four visits a year. Twice a Year takes 10% off, Triannual 15%, Quarterly 15% and Every 2 Months 20%.
